translations.web: Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”
translations.bsb: But Moses replied, “Please, Lord, send someone else.”
translations.kjv: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.
translations.asv: And he said, Oh, Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.
